summary: Clear inherited Git overrides before restoring
body: If the coachman inherits `GIT_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE`, Git honors those variables despite `-C`, so this `reset --hard` can target the caller’s worktree instead of this run’s synthesis worktree; earlier snapshots can also inspect the wrong repository. Unset these overrides for every Git subprocess in this control.

summary: Split conditional-OR chains before classifying commands
body: For a recorded command such as `false || touch ~/outside.txt`, `splitShell` leaves `||` in the same segment and `commandTouches` treats `false` as the command; the `touch` target is classified only as a read, so the write does not become a finding or escalation. Split `||` at the command boundary just as `&&` is split.

summary: Parse command substitutions inside double quotes
body: With a command such as `echo "$(touch ~/outside.txt)"`, this condition skips the substitution because `quote` is `"`; the inner `touch` is treated as part of `echo`’s argument, and `expandPath` cannot resolve that token, so the write is missed. Recognize `$()` substitutions inside double quotes too.
